caption:
Your due date and your statement date are not the same thing.
Many issuers report your balance around the statement date, so a big balance can show up even if you pay in full later.
Check your card's statement closing date in the app.
Do you know yours?
first_comment: Do you know your statement closing date? 👇

card.headline: Know your statement date, not just the due date
card.sub: Balances are often reported when it closes
